clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old volunteer is being evaluated as a potential bone marrow donor.
morphology_cue_template: Age-appropriate cellularity with a range of maturing granulocytes.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old undergoes marrow evaluation for persistent but otherwise unexplained mild blood-count abnormalities.
morphology_cue_template: Age-appropriate cellularity and a complete granulocytic maturation spectrum.
editor_note: A reassuring marrow does not establish cause of abnormal CBC

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old with previously unexplained mild cytopenias undergoes a bone marrow biopsy.
morphology_cue_template: Preserved granulocytic maturation with no prominent excess of blasts.
editor_note: Simplified normal-appearing sample; other lineages omitted

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old is evaluated after an incidental abnormal blood count that has since normalized.
morphology_cue_template: Age-appropriate marrow fat and orderly granulocytic maturation.
editor_note: Vignette does not assert why counts normalized

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old undergoes marrow examination during follow-up of a previously treated hematologic condition.
morphology_cue_template: No evident blast expansion; granulocytes show a full range of maturation.
editor_note: Normal-appearing morphology alone does not establish remission

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old reports fatigue and easy bruising; peripheral blood shows circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: Increased blasts with reduced normal granulocytic maturation.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old develops pallor and bruises easily; blasts are identified on the blood smear.
morphology_cue_template: Blast-rich marrow with reduced normal maturation.

clinical_vignette_template: Routine bloodwork in a {age}-year-old reveals new pancytopenia and circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: An expanded blast population dominates the illustrated granulocytic compartment.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old presents with fever and severe neutropenia; review of the blood film finds blasts.
morphology_cue_template: Marked expansion of immature blasts with diminished mature granulocytes.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old develops gingival bleeding and fatigue, with new thrombocytopenia and circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: Blast-rich marrow with little normal granulocytic maturation.
editor_note: Do not infer monocytic lineage from current artwork

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old presents with marked leukocytosis, anemia, and numerous circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: An expanded blast population with suppressed normal maturation.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old previously treated with cytotoxic chemotherapy develops new cytopenias and circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: Blast expansion in a marrow with variable cellularity.
editor_note: Prior therapy alone does not define a specific AML genetic category

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old with recurrent fever and fatigue is found to have anemia, thrombocytopenia, and circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: An increased blast population and reduced late granulocytic forms.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old is evaluated for markedly elevated white blood cells and splenomegaly.
morphology_cue_template: Granulocytic hyperplasia with a left shift and preserved maturation.
editor_note: Requires molecular confirmation; basophilia not depicted

clinical_vignette_template: Routine bloodwork in a {age}-year-old reveals persistent leukocytosis with immature granulocytes.
morphology_cue_template: Hypercellular marrow with many myelocytes and metamyelocytes.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old reports early satiety; examination reveals splenomegaly and bloodwork shows leukocytosis.
morphology_cue_template: Expanded granulopoiesis with the full maturation spectrum.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old has incidental leukocytosis on a preoperative blood count; the smear shows a granulocytic left shift.
morphology_cue_template: Marked granulocytic proliferation, particularly intermediate precursors.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old presents with fatigue and abdominal fullness; the CBC shows leukocytosis with granulocytic precursors.
morphology_cue_template: Full spectrum of myeloid maturation in a hypercellular marrow.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old presents with fatigue, recurrent infections, and pancytopenia.
morphology_cue_template: Very sparse hematopoiesis with extensive fat spaces.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old with persistent pancytopenia undergoes a bone marrow biopsy.
morphology_cue_template: Markedly hypocellular marrow with only scattered hematopoietic cells.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old develops easy bruising and recurrent oral infections; blood counts are low in all three lineages.
morphology_cue_template: Extensive fatty replacement and scant residual granulopoiesis.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old is referred for severe anemia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia without circulating blasts.
morphology_cue_template: Marked hypocellularity with only rare maturing granulocytes.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old undergoes marrow examination two weeks after intensive cytotoxic chemotherapy.
morphology_cue_template: Treatment-associated hypocellularity with very few residual myeloid cells.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old has persistent cytopenias after intensive chemotherapy.
morphology_cue_template: Markedly depleted hematopoiesis with prominent fat spaces.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old with treated acute leukemia undergoes an early post-induction marrow biopsy.
morphology_cue_template: Sparse marrow cellularity following treatment.
editor_note: Cannot infer leukemia clearance from cellularity alone

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old remains profoundly neutropenic after a recent course of cytotoxic chemotherapy.
morphology_cue_template: Very limited residual granulopoiesis in a markedly hypocellular sample.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old has rising neutrophil counts after a period of chemotherapy-related pancytopenia.
morphology_cue_template: Regenerating granulopoiesis with a variable left shift.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old is recovering blood counts several weeks after cytotoxic treatment.
morphology_cue_template: Reappearing granulocytic precursors and increasing late forms.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old returns for marrow evaluation as blood counts begin to recover after treatment.
morphology_cue_template: Recovering hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes at several stages.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old recovering from intensive chemotherapy now has a rising absolute neutrophil count.
morphology_cue_template: Regenerating marrow with increased intermediate granulocytic forms.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old recently received filgrastim after chemotherapy.
morphology_cue_template: Expanded granulopoiesis with a left shift, compatible with G-CSF effect.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old received pegfilgrastim during a recent chemotherapy cycle.
morphology_cue_template: Granulocytic hyperplasia with numerous maturing precursors.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old is undergoing peripheral blood stem-cell mobilization after several days of filgrastim.
morphology_cue_template: Granulocytic proliferation and a broad maturation spectrum.

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old with recurrent bacterial infections is evaluated for persistent severe neutropenia.
morphology_cue_template: Promyelocytes and myelocytes predominate, with few mature neutrophils.
editor_note: Pattern varies by cause and treatment

clinical_vignette_template: A {age}-year-old has had profound neutropenia and recurrent infections since early childhood.
morphology_cue_template: Maturation is markedly reduced beyond early granulocytic precursor stages.
